_comment: Tier-1 Welch ANOVA on revenue across the four regions. Region-level lifts (1.0×, 1.10×, 1.22×, 1.35×) multiply onto a log-normal base, so the per-region variances are visibly unequal. Welch's F handles heteroscedasticity without inflating the type-I rate. Streams via per-group online Welford state.
